name: Compressor Creator Studio
description:
Compressor is a powerful video encoding and export application for macOS. It is available as a standalone purchase or as part of the Apple Creator Studio subscription bundle, which also includes apps like Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, and Motion.

Key Features of Compressor
✶ Format Flexibility: Export video to virtually any output format or container.
✶ Batch Processing: Encode large numbers of media files simultaneously.
✶ Advanced Delivery: Package movies for the iTunes Store, deliver HDR video, and manage closed captions or subtitles.
✶ Workflow Integration: Works seamlessly alongside Final Cut Pro and Motion for rendering and output management.
